purpose: Demo only; timings and three reverse adjustments are not production thresholds.
message: Pumps may be swapped. Check the L/R labels on the device and try again.
angleConvention: Negative = counterclockwise on the on-screen guide; guide asks for clockwise correction toward zero.
onPrompt: Show the correct wearing illustration in a confirmation dialog; keep pumping paused and angles unchanged. Confirmation returns to adjustment, not success.

correctAdjustment.start: Current displayed left/right angles; cancel preceding wrong animation and toast.
correctAdjustment.result: Both angles reach zero; show aligned state for 1.2 seconds, then continue existing wearing-check success flow.

wrongAdjustment: Continue reverse motion from the current angle. At 7200ms show the L/R confirmation dialog instead of the former swapped-pumps Toast.

waitingForAdjustment.repeat: Only on initial detection and sheet presentation. Do not repeat after a wrong adjustment Toast.

copy.l: Adjust the left pump as shown.
copy.r: Adjust the right pump as shown.

waitingForAdjustment.note: Timings are for Mock demonstration only; UI remains English, trigger controls are Chinese.
waitingForAdjustment.promptTrigger: After the wearing sheet entrance/expansion finishes, followed by a 200 ms visual separation; cancelled on adjustment or dismissal.

triggerAvailability.佩戴角度异常: Available during an active pumping session; opens adjustment and pauses the session.
triggerAvailability.调反了 / 调对了: Enabled only while the visible wearing sheet is in its angle adjustment stage. Otherwise disabled and ignored without changing state.

toastTiming.rule: max(3500ms, 1800ms + English word units / 3 * 1000 + CJK character count / 5 * 1000), rounded up to 250ms
toastTiming.longWords: Each word contributes at least 1 unit, or character count / 8 if greater.
toastTiming.scope: Transient wearing, reversed-side, battery and export-error Toasts. Device/business countdowns remain independent.

firstUse.trigger: First Start Pumping, before angle check, even if Pre-Pumping Check is disabled.
firstUse.confirm: Persist per-device confirmation, then continue the existing startup flow.
firstUse.cancel: No persistence or pumping; show again next time.
